model_annotation: This chart is a line graph depicting the relationship between a variable on the x-axis and the F12 values on the y-axis across three different methods: lattice, FLAT, and Ours. The x-axis is labeled "epouch (x)" and ranges from 0 to 18, with markers at regular intervals. The y-axis is labeled "F12" with values ranging from 0.55 to 0.90, also marked at regular intervals. The lattice method, represented by a line with red squares, starts just above 0.60 on the y-axis at an epouch of 0 and decreases steadily to just below 0.65 at an epouch of 18. The FLAT method, shown with a blue line with triangles, begins at approximately 0.70, dips to a low of around 0.65 between epouch 4 and 6, then rises back up to roughly 0.75 at an epouch of 14, and drops again towards 0.70 at epouch 18. The method labeled "Ours," depicted with a yellow line with arrows, starts at around 0.80, peaks just below 0.85 at an epouch of 4, and exhibits a slight decreasing trend to approximately 0.75 by epouch 18. The lines intersect at various points, with the FLAT and Ours lines intersecting twice, once between epouch 4 and 6, and another around epouch 12.
